scope: v27.5.1 adds Visual Music motion media and a still Hermes Workspace interface preview. Existing Pelagic and Kona refreshes retain their original capture records; Codex × Hermes and Kattis retain their restored original Worlds previews. Preserve the existing eight identities, relative order, media and actions, native fields and protected travel.

entries.name: pelagic-jellyfish-webgl
entries.note: Original native Deep D sanctuary, progress 1 / fixed FOV 50. Original scene, rock lighting and anatomy; 1/60 simulation steps, 30fps capture. Reused 1440x700 frames with disclosed 0.5s lap dissolve; fitted without cropping.

entries.name: konata-hyprland-dotfiles
entries.note: Original native Kona V3 master at 1000/33fps, sampled at 30fps. Reused full 960x540 frames; Wi-Fi SSID and weather privacy edits retained, 0.3s lap dissolve. No upscale or optical-flow frames. Konata artwork remains owned by its rights holders.

entries.name: visual-music
entries.note: Actual locally captured Visual Music runtime at the recorded source revision. The public website is a newer deployment; this preview documents its captured revision rather than claiming a byte-identical production recording.

entries.name: hermes-workspace
entries.note: Actual published Hermes Workspace interface, shown as a still with labelled documentation fixtures. The capture establishes interface appearance, without claiming a live inference response or VM qualification.
